lines: A caravan bell half under the sand. Its clapper is tied to a camel's tooth. Lucky charm. Was.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell on a stake, polished by the wind. Someone carved 'turn back' into it, then 'just kidding'.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell in a dry bush. It rings when nobody touches it. You decide not to think about that.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell with a name tag: 'Gulnar, lead camel, very opinionated.'
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell on a broken pole. The pole points at the kiln. Poles don't lie. People do.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.

bell_empty: An empty stake. The wind whistles where the bell used to ring.

lines: A heliograph mirror on a post, tilted at the sky. It flashes at nobody in particular.
You turn the mirror back toward the sun. It flashes, very pleased with itself.

helio_1_plain: A heliograph mirror on a post, tilted at the sky. It flashes at nobody in particular.

lines: A heliograph mirror, cracked down the middle. It sends every message twice, slightly wrong.
You turn the mirror back toward the sun. It flashes, very pleased with itself.

helio_2_plain: A heliograph mirror, cracked down the middle. It sends every message twice, slightly wrong.

lines: A heliograph mirror pointed at the kiln. Its shutter is oiled. Someone uses this one a lot.
You turn the mirror back toward the sun. It flashes, very pleased with itself.

helio_3_plain: A heliograph mirror pointed at the kiln. Its shutter is oiled. Someone uses this one a lot.
sign: East: Ochrewell. South: the Mirage Kiln. Everywhere else: sand, and opinions about sand.
kiln_sign: MIRAGE KILN - GLASS SOLD, NOT TOLD.
Under it, in smaller paint: 'Lost caravans, please use the back door.'
kesh: Kesh: Rung one. I'm the welcome mat of the ladder. Everybody wipes their feet on me.
kesh_intro: Kesh: Ladder rules: you lose, you buy the water. Water is expensive out here.
kesh_defeat: Kesh: Wiped. Go on, rung two's past the rocks.
mabli: Mabli: I trade salt for water and water for salt. Some days I come out ahead. Never both days.
mabli_intro: Mabli: Rung two. Salt in the wound, as we say.
mabli_defeat: Mabli: Rinse and repeat. With what water, though.
fennel: Fennel: I used to stoke the Mirage Kiln. Then I learned what they were baking. Now I stoke this ladder.
fennel_intro: Fennel: Rung three's hot. Mind your fingers.
fennel_defeat: Fennel: Burned out. Story of my life.
pell: Old Pell: I've climbed this ladder forty times. Never got paid. Never learned. Very consistent.
pell_intro: Old Pell: Rung four. Halfway. That's where most people start counting their money. Don't.
pell_defeat: Old Pell: Good. Now listen: when you win, make Sabine write the promise on the ladder board. In chalk. With a witness.
Old Pell: My goat will witness. She's very reliable. More than Sabine, anyway.
yusra: Yusra: I dance in the heat shimmer. From far away I look like an oasis. Up close, I look like a bill.
yusra_intro: Yusra: Rung five. Try not to fall for me. Everyone does, then they fall off.
yusra_defeat: Yusra: Real after all. How disappointing for both of us.
brannt: Brannt: I guard caravans. Fewer every year. I'm starting to think it's the bells.
brannt_intro: Brannt: Rung six. Last one outside. After me, it's Sabine's house, Sabine's rules.
brannt_defeat: Brannt: Go on in. Count your fingers after you shake her hand.
